Package com.arthroverse.vf17.detection

Class DetectionHandler

java.lang.Object
com.arthroverse.vf17.detection.DetectionHandler
public class DetectionHandler extends Object
Handles real-time camera capture and YOLOv8 inference for VF17 detection. It draws detection overlays, manages a virtual trigger line, and sends serial signals to Arduino based on detected object classes and line-crossing logic.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Duc Phat Hoang (25phat.hd@vinuni.edu.vn), Ngo Van Thang (25thang.nv@vinuni.edu.vn), Mai Dinh Vinh (25vinh.md@vinuni.edu.vn)

  • Method Details

    • startCamera

      public void startCamera()
      This OpenCV camera activation syntax is the same as the Python syntax with the 
           camera = new VideoCapture(0);

      This is the python syntax 

           import cv2
     cap = cv.VideoCapture(0);

      There are 2 lines for camera resolution changes and 1 line to activate a separate thread service for the OpenCV camera to prevent thread issue

    • hasPassed

      private boolean hasPassed(YOLOv8Detector.Detection det)
      Computes whether a detection has passed the virtual trigger line, based on a configurable trigger point inside the bounding box and the selected motion direction.
      Parameters:
      det - the detection whose position is used for line-crossing evaluation
      Returns:
      true if the detection has passed the trigger line based on the configured direction; otherwise false

    • shouldTriggerOutput

      private boolean shouldTriggerOutput(String className, boolean currentlyPassed)
      This method will determine whether to trigger the output and also send a serial signal to the Arduino board to activate the servo pusing

      Each object will have a trigger id (based on their class name). If that id is inside the set of all previously triggered ids, then they will be ignored => method returns false

      Otherwise the method will trigger a 3000ms cooldown in the main Thread and return true and then remove the triggeredid out of the set
